title: Freshdesk Ticket Summary
summary: Summarise each new Freshdesk ticket in three bullets and add it as a private note for the agent who picks it up.

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret used to verify inbound Freshdesk webhooks (HMAC-SHA256).

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Your Freshdesk subdomain, for example `acme` for acme.freshdesk.com.

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_API_KEY
secrets.description: Freshdesk API key (used as the Basic auth username).

secrets.name: FRESHDESK_API_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Basic auth password. Freshdesk accepts any value, for example `X`.

setup: Publish the playbook and copy its webhook URL from Studio.
In Freshdesk, create an automation rule on ticket creation that calls the webhook with the ticket fields.
Create a test ticket and watch the run in Studio.
